title: Affine algebra adjunction unit isomorphism
statement: Let f:X→Y be an affine scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Let g be the canonical morphism to the direct image algebra space (Y,f_* O_X) [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category], and let G=g_* be module direct image [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image] on module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume G is a right adjoint and use its canonical left adjoint and adjunction. Then the canonical adjunction unit is an isomorphism at every quasi-coherent f_* O_X-module. Quasi-coherence is the property of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-module-correspondence].

proof.text: Obtain the two tensor functors, pinned comparison maps and β from affine_module_correspondence. Apply the tensor Hom-bijection theorem to these witnesses.

Form each Hom equivalence with Equiv.ofBijective applied to a↦β_M followed by R(a). Left naturality follows from β.naturality and functoriality of R; right naturality follows from associativity and R.map_comp. Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv gives an adjunction with unit β, since the image of id is β. The affine correspondence makes this unit invertible at each quasi-coherent M. Finally use unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app to express the canonical unit as β followed by R of the unique left-adjoint comparison isomorphism. Functors preserve isomorphisms and compositions of isomorphisms are isomorphisms.
